4 {{Steel}} |} ==Trivia== *The male Templar helm is used as the hard mode mission outpost and Vanquishing icon and also as the standard icon for the game's exe-file. It is also shown on [[Tournament Token]]s. *During [[Character#Creation|character creation]], the warrior is wearing a helmet similar to Templar helm in the primary [[profession]] selection screen. *Templar armor was at one point known as Knight's armor. *The Issue #12 (December 2004) of the GuildMaster Photics Fansite Magazine featured a beta version of the [[Nolani Academy (cinematics)]], showing that originally Rurik's appearance was a warrior with a green-dyed early Templar armor. This [[Nolani_Academy_(cinematics)#Gallery|preliminary version of the armor]] was later reworked to the current one when the game was officially released. {{warrior armor nav}} [[Category:Warrior armor|Templar]] [[Category:Prophecies armor]] [[Category:PvP armor]] [[Category:PvP reward armor]]
